name: Pelóri
hint: the Mountains of Aman, highest of the world: a curved wall near the east coast from north to south, pierced only by the Calacirya

name: Taniquetil
hint: Oiolossë, Mount Everwhite: highest mountain of the world, on the borders of the sea; Ilmarin on its summit. South of the pass after the HoME maps

name: Hyarmentir
hint: highest mountain of the southern Pelóri, above Avathar; Melkor and Ungoliant climbed it to look on Valinor

name: Túna
hint: the green hill raised in the Calacirya; Tirion stands on its crown

name: Ezellohar
hint: Corollairë, the green mound before the western gate of Valmar where the Two Trees grew

name: Lórellin
hint: approx: the lake in the gardens of Lórien; Estë sleeps by day on the tree-grown isle in it

name: Wells of Varda
hint: approx: Varda's great vats of the dew of Telperion and the light of Laurelin, near the Trees; Ungoliant drank them

name: Woods of Oromë
hint: the forests of the Huntsman in the south of Valinor, at the feet of Hyarmentir

name: Gardens of Lórien
hint: approx: the gardens of Irmo, fairest place in the world, with the lake Lórellin; placed south of Valmar

name: Valmar
hint: Valimar of many bells, city of the Valar in the midst of the plain of Valinor

name: Tirion
hint: white city of the Vanyar and Noldor on the crown of Túna in the Calacirya

name: Mindon Eldaliéva
hint: the tower of Ingwë in Tirion, whose lamp shone far out to sea

name: Alqualondë
hint: the Haven of the Swans, city of the Teleri on the coast of Eldamar north of the Calacirya

name: Avallónë
hint: haven of the Eldar on the east side of Tol Eressëa, facing the sea; of the Second Age (Akallabêth)

name: Formenos
hint: Fëanor's stronghold and treasury in the hills in the north of Valinor; Finwë was slain at its doors

name: Ilmarin
hint: the halls of Manwë and Varda on the summit of Taniquetil

name: Halls of Mandos
hint: approx: the Halls of Awaiting in the west of Valinor by the shore of the Outer Sea

name: Halls of Nienna
hint: approx: halls west of West upon the borders of the world, near the Halls of Mandos

name: Mansions of Aulë
hint: approx: the halls of the Smith of the Valar in Valinor; the text gives no place

name: Door of Night
hint: approx: the door in the Walls of the Night beyond Ekkaia; the Ambarkanta (HoME IV) puts it in the far west, beyond the edge of this sheet; Morgoth was thrust through it into the Void after the War of Wrath (Silmarillion ch. 24)

name: Gates of Valmar
hint: the golden gates of Valmar on its west side, facing Ezellohar and the Ring of Doom

name: Máhanaxar
hint: the Ring of Doom, where the Valar sat in council, near the golden gates of Valmar

name: Calacirya
hint: the Pass of Light, the one cleft through the Pelóri, made for the Eldar; the light of the Trees flowed out through it

name: Tol Eressëa
hint: the Lonely Isle, ferry of the Eldar, rooted by Ulmo in the Bay of Eldamar

name: Enchanted Isles
hint: chain of isles set from north to south in the Shadowy Seas at the Hiding of Valinor (after the Flight of the Noldor)

name: Bay of Eldamar
hint: the great bay of Elvenhome east of the Calacirya, with Tol Eressëa in it

name: Ekkaia
hint: the Outer Sea that surrounds the world, west of Valinor

name: Belegaer
hint: the Great Sea between Aman and Middle-earth; the Sundering Seas

name: Caves of the Forgotten
hint: approx: where Ar-Pharazôn and his warriors lie under the hills that fell on them about Túna (Second Age, Akallabêth)

name: Aman
hint: radius about 1100 km. the Blessed Realm, the Undying Lands in the West

name: Valinor
hint: radius about 620 km. land of the Valar west of the Pelóri, from the mountains to the Outer Sea

name: Eldamar
hint: radius about 110 km. Elvenhome: the coast and bay east of the Calacirya, with Tirion and Alqualondë

name: Araman
hint: radius about 200 km. cold waste between the Pelóri and the sea in the north; the Doom of Mandos was spoken here

name: Avathar
hint: radius about 260 km. narrow dark land between the Pelóri and the sea in the south; Ungoliant dwelt in a ravine here

name: Oiomúrë
hint: radius about 80 km. region of mists on the coast of Araman near the Helcaraxë

name: Helcaraxë
hint: radius about 170 km. the Grinding Ice between Araman and Middle-earth; Fingolfin crossed it

name: Shadowy Seas
hint: radius about 260 km. dark seas east of Tol Eressëa, shadowed after the Hiding of Valinor (after the Flight of the Noldor)

name: Pastures of Yavanna
hint: radius about 170 km. the fields of Yavanna in the south of Valinor, west of the woods of Oromë
